directions.plain: You post often and spend nothing. You keep the steady pace that works.
directions.title: Keep Posting What Already Works
directions.why_for_you: Last month you came very close to your goal with no spend. Your on hand photos get the most love.
directions.you_would_do: Post five times a week using mostly on hand photos with a few close ups and flat lays.

directions.caution: Some sent pieces never get posted, so start early and do not count on every parcel.
directions.plain: You send free pieces to women your shopper follows. They post real wearing photos for you.
directions.title: Send Pieces To Small Creators
directions.why_for_you: Creator posts earn more love than your own posts. That fits young women who trust real faces.
directions.you_would_do: Message twenty small creators your shopper follows and ship pieces to those who reply, then share their on hand photos.

directions.caution: Use this sparingly or shoppers may learn to wait for a sale.
directions.plain: You pick one week for a small price cut. You tell followers it ends on Sunday.
directions.title: Run One Simple Discount Week
directions.why_for_you: Sale weeks pull much stronger in your past data. That can help in a busy shopping month.
directions.you_would_do: Post five times that week with mostly on hand and close up photos and put the sale dates in each caption.

directions.caution: Ads cost more this month and you spent nothing on ads last month, so test small before you spend big.
directions.plain: You put money behind photos that already work. You show them to more women like your buyer.
directions.title: Boost Your Best Posts With Ads
directions.why_for_you: Your on hand photos already get the most love, so they are the safest to boost.
directions.you_would_do: Pick your two best on hand posts and show them as ads all month to women like your buyer.

season_note: November brings stronger demand at 1.13 but pricier ads at 1.18.
